purpose: Test a simpler statistically valid Shapley safe-elimination route: sample complete player permutations uniformly without replacement, treat each player's permutation marginal as a finite-population observation, and use a time-uniform WoR confidence sequence while accounting cost in unique coalition-value evaluations.

sampling_design.draw: uniform without replacement from the 10! permutation population
sampling_design.identity: Shapley phi_i equals the finite-population mean of x_i(pi) over all 10! permutations
sampling_design.cache: coalition values on each permutation path are globally cached across permutations
sampling_design.budget_snapshot_rule: Before each new permutation draw, store the current estimate/CS snapshot and current unique-coalition-call count. Draw and fully evaluate the next permutation. For a budget B, report the latest pre-draw snapshot whose cost is <=B; never peek at a newly drawn permutation and reject it because of its prospective cache cost.
sampling_design.duplicate_permutations: forbidden; maintain a set of sampled permutation ranks/tuples

confidence.method: Waudby-Smith and Ramdas 2020 binary hypergeometric prior-posterior-ratio confidence sequence
confidence.simultaneity: Each player CS is time-uniform; Bonferroni over 10 players gives familywise <=0.05 for all reported stopping times.
confidence.source: Waudby-Smith & Ramdas, Confidence Sequences for Sampling Without Replacement, NeurIPS 2020, Theorem 2.1

safe_elimination.rule: certify phi_i <= epsilon only when the player's time-uniform upper CS endpoint <= epsilon, or after exact coalition completion
safe_elimination.exact_zero: By default requires exact coalition completion or a structural proof; statistical CS is primarily an epsilon-negligibility certificate.

metrics: remaining exact-completion cost at each snapshot

comparison.primary_question: Does direct permutation-WoR inference achieve safer or cheaper certification than vertex-WoR HT and coalition-size marginal-stratified WoR under the same deterministic game and unique coalition-value cost accounting?

next_action: Implement exact permutation ranking/sampling and the binary PPR confidence sequence; validate the PPR CS on tiny exhaustively enumerable finite populations before running the frozen 10-player budget grid.
